cell_spans.description: Printed spanning heading 'Design Flow conditions, in lps' covers the three flow columns.
'Average flow' is printed on two lines in its header cell.

notes: Printed spanning heading reads 'Design Flow conditions, in lps'. The first character after 'in' is a bare vertical stroke in the source and is not distinguishable as capital I or lower case l; transcribed as 'lps', the abbreviation printed in the pumpage boxes of the same figure.
Row label 'C1-C' is printed with the C1 pump box shown below the spine between B and C; the cell is preserved exactly as printed.

The same figure prints four pumpage boxes: A 'Low flow 15 lps / Average flow 20 lps / Peak flow 45 lps'; B 'Low flow 20 lps / Average flow 30 lps / Peak flow 65 lps'; C1 'Low flow 30 lps / Average flow 50 lps / Peak flow 120 lps'. C has no flow values printed beside it.
Unnumbered table embedded in a figure; p302-1 is a service locator, not a printed table number.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 200-600 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed page is landscape; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed.
